query Movies($countryId: String!, $category: String, $cinemas: String, $after: String, $limit: Int, $isAbsoluteMediaPath: Boolean) {
  movies(
    countryId: $countryId
    category: $category
    cinemas: $cinemas
    after: $after
    limit: $limit
    isAbsoluteMediaPath: $isAbsoluteMediaPath
  ) {
    pageInfo {
      startCursor
      endCursor
      hasNextPage
      hasPreviousPage
      __typename
    }
    totalCount
    edges {
      cursor
      node {
        id
        type
        countryId
        name
        originalName
        distributor
        rating
        ratingDescription
        position
        genre
        synopsis
        length
        availableForSale
        alerts {
          title
          message
          __typename
        }
        releaseDate
        languages
        formats
        tags {
          name
          resource
          __typename
        }
        media {
          resource
          type
          code
          sizes {
            large
            medium
            small
            __typename
          }
          __typename
        }
        cities
        cinemas
        categories
        experiences {
          icon
          name
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
